NSIC enlists Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) under Single Point Registration scheme (SPRS) for participation in Government Purchases. The units enlisted under Single Point Registration Scheme of NSIC are eligible to get the benefits under Public Procurement Policy for Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order 2012 as notified by the Government of India, Ministry of Micro Small & Medium Enterprises, New Delhi vide Gazette Notification dated 23.03.2012 and amendment vide order no. S.O. 5670(E) dated 9th November 2018. The enlistment under SPRS is completely online. Login: www.nsicspronline.com

Issue of the Tender Sets free of cost.
Exemption from payment of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD).
In tender participating MSEs quoting price within price band of L1+15 per cent shall also be allowed to supply a portion upto 25% of requirement by bringing down their price to L1 Price, where L1 is non MSEs.
Consortia facility for Tender Marketing.

Every Central Ministries/Departments/PSUs shall set an annual goal of minimum 25 per cent of the total annual purchases of the products or services produced or rendered by MSEs. Out of annual requirement of 25% procurement from MSEs, 4% is earmarked for units owned by Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribes and 3% is earmarked for the units owned by entrepreneurs. SPRS registered units are integral part of the supply chain to Government.
In addition to the above, 358 items are also reserved for exclusive purchase from MSE Sector (see download section, item 7).

All Micro & Small Enterprises having Udyam Registration are eligible for registration with NSIC under its Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS).
1c) Micro & Small Enterprises who have already commenced their commercial production but not completed one year of existence. The Provisional Registration Certificate can be issued to such Micro & Small Enterprises under Single Point Registration scheme with monetary limit of Rs. 5.00 Lacs.

Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) involved in manufacturing & Services are eligible for registration.
Traders are not eligible for registration under this Scheme.
The validity of SPRS Certificate is of 2 years from the date of registration and thereafter renewed after every two years.
MSEs already commenced their commercial production (Start Ups) but not completed one year of existence are eligible for Provisional Registration for one year. MSEs can apply for full registration after completion of one year.

Please visit Udyam Registration website for obtaining Udyam Registration Number.
Each step has to be filled & every step has saved and continues option. This way form can be refilled and reviewed at any moment using PAN and Udyam combination.
It is requested to go through Check-List and Download section to get to know about required forms, annexure and documents.
It is always advisable to kindly place all required forms, annexure and documents on your desktop in a folder for fast uploading.
Fees will be charged on the basis of Unit Enterprise category (Micro or Small).

Third party inspection is also involved for store item inspection. Units are requested to kindly choose inspection agency according to their domain expertise and jurisdiction.
Final Certificate will be available online and respective NSIC office will send physical certificate copy by post.
For any communications, the registration number of certificate may be quoted.
Contact our NSIC field offices for any query by visiting Our Offices.
2c) Where the MSE is having more than one factory located in the same state or outside the state, all the factories shall be registered at one branch and the application as such shall be considered at one branch only.

The validity of SPRS Certificate is of 2 years from the date of registration and MSE unit can apply for renewal 6 months before expiry of certificate.
MSEs coming for renewal before expiry of SPRS certificate get discount of 50% on renewal fee.
MSE units having no change from previous issued Certificate can apply renewal online.

4c) Renewal & amendment when both are applied together would attract only Renewal fee.

The registration Fee is based on the Turnover as per latest audited Balance Sheet of the Micro & Small Enterprise for the Registration, Renewal and any other amendment etc.
Nominal fee on SPRS registration for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe at Rs.100/- + GST (From 2021-22 to 2025-26).
MSEs located in North Eastern Region are entitled for 20% concession in fee (Fee for Technical Inspections of MSEs will remain the same).
5b) You may visit Fee Calculator for calculation of Fee.

Monetary limit of the company is fixed on the basis of the unit's net sales turnover during the last three years reflected in the Audited Balance Sheets.
Monetary limit will be fixed on the basis of highest turnover during the last three years which may or may not be of last year provided the unit's installed and operating capacity has not been reduced.
In case there is no decrease in plant and machinery, then 50% of highest turnover during the last 3 years reflected in audited balance sheet will be the basis for fixation of monetary limit.
In case there is decrease in plant and machinery for more than 10%, the following will be considered.

Where the turnover of the Enterprise has steadily increased over the last three years and the unit is in profit continuously, the Monetary Limit may be fixed at 50% of net sales turnover achieved in the last year.
In case the Company/Partnership concern/Proprietorship unit is in loss for one year out of past three years, their monetary limit will be fixed at 40% of their average net sales turnover.
Similarly, when the Micro & Small Enterprise is in loss for two years out of the past three years, the monetary limit will be accordingly fixed at 30% of their average net sales turnover of the past three years.

In the event of Micro & Small Enterprise being in loss throughout past three years, the monetary limit of the Unit will be fixed at 20% of the average net sales turnover of the Unit during the past three years.

The MSEs engaged in following activities are not eligible for registration under Single Point Registration Scheme:
Manufacture of Medicine and drugs except MSE (unit) engaged in manufacturing and supply of Ayurvedic, Unani, Sidha and Homeopathic Medicines.
Wholesale trading, Retail Trading or commission agents.
The MSEs who have been black listed till expiry of such period.
The proprietor/partner/director/Karta of the MSEs has been convicted for any criminal offence.

Merely submission of online form does not entitle a MSE to get Single Point Registration certificate. Those MSEs with valid documents and passed third party inspection with all fees/dues cleared will be eligible for SPRS certificate.

MSME SAARTHI stands for Scheme for Assistance Acceleration by Reach THrough Independent Associates.
The MSME SAARTHI is an initiative by The National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC) to expand its outreach and strengthen engagement with Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) across India.
This scheme introduces a cost-effective, scalable, and partnership-driven model to bridge the gap between NSIC services and untapped MSMEs. MSME SAARTHIs will work as business lead provider/extending arms of NSIC educating NSIC's Scheme to MSMEs for sourcing new business.

The MSME SAARTHI aims to expand NSIC activities across India to serve more and more MSMEs. Under this scheme:
MSME SAARTHI act as extended arms and business lead providers for NSIC.
They promote NSIC schemes and connect with MSMEs to generate new business leads.
They play a key role in market expansion and growth including untapped areas.
Multiple MSME SAARTHIs can be appointed within a single region or office to maximize outreach.

To expand NSIC's reach, focus on India's MSME sector through the MSME SAARTHI channel, aligning with NSIC's broader objectives of enhancing branding, promoting and driving revenue growth within this crucial segment. The scheme also covers untapped MSMEs, startups, women and NER entrepreneurs, along with socially disadvantaged groups such as SC/ST, minorities, and differently abled individuals.

MSME SAARTHIs will generate leads under following schemes of NSIC:
Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS).
E-Marketing Services through MSME Global Mart.
Exhibitions organized by NSIC.
Selective Training Courses conducted from NTSCs.
Common Facility Services provided at NTSCs.
Raw Material Assistance against Bank Guarantee (RMA).
Assistance to Wholesalers and Retail Traders Scheme (AWRT).
Any scheme introduced in future may also be applicable to MSME SAARTHI as per the approval of the competent authority on case-to-case basis.

Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
Practicing Chartered Accountant (CA) / Cost Accountant (CMA) / Company Secretary (CS)
National/State Government agencies dealing with MSME sector at large
SNP approved by ONDC eligible to generate leads for SPRS & B2B only.

For Practicing CA/CMA/CS or their Firm: Minimum ₹5 lakh turnover
Minimum 3 years of existence, except for practicing CAs, CMAs, CSs, or their firms, for whom a minimum of 1 year of experience is required
Relevant experience preferred

NSIC employees (past/present) & their immediate family members
Directors, their relatives and entities
Person with criminal background and/or Entities Blacklisted by Any Institution or RBI

MSME SAARTHI is required to submit an online application (Annexure-"1") along with an application fee of ₹1,000 + GST (exempt for Government entities), supported by documents as per Annexure-"2".
The submitted application will be processed for further evaluation and approval.
Upon approval, MSME SAARTHI has to submit a security deposit of ₹10,000/- (Exempted for Government entities) which shall be non-interest bearing and not subject to any interest payment by NSIC, refundable at the time of completion/termination/withdrawal of the Agreement.
Link to Apply online — saarthi.nsic.co.in
The Facilitation Charges/Professional Fees will be given to MSME SAARTHI on the New Business as applicable.
The selected MSME SAARTHI would be initially engaged for a period of 02 years which can be renewed for further period.
Merely submission of online form does not entitle an MSME SAARTHI to get enrolled in MSME SAARTHI Scheme of NSIC.
